caption: Santa Maria dell'Isola, Tropea
composition: White sanctuary on the sea stack below Tropea's cliff town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the sandy beach, the camera looks up at the white sanctuary of Santa Maria dell'Isola crowning its rocky sea stack at the left, the domed church gleaming in the clear 09:03 morning sun. To the right, the greater headland rises in layered cliffs topped by Tropea's pale houses, while turquoise water laps the empty beach that curves across the foreground. The deep blue sky and the vivid sea give the whole scene a bright, crystalline clarity.
